competitor_context.headline: Teradyne and broader semiconductor/AI stocks slid on a global bond-yield selloff in early September
competitor_context.implication_for_target: The same global rates-driven derisking that hit US AI/semiconductor names also weighed on Japanese AI-automation names like FANUC in the same window, indicating the move was a shared macro shock rather than FANUC-specific weakness.
